title: FAT Attendance Policy
text: Students must maintain at least 75% attendance to be eligible to write the FAT (Final Assessment Test). Students between 65-74% may be eligible for condonation with a valid medical certificate.

title: Revaluation Policy
text: Revaluation requests must be submitted through the student portal within 5 days of result declaration, along with the prescribed revaluation fee per subject.

title: Library Hours
text: The Main Library is open Monday through Thursday from 7:00 AM to midnight, Friday from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and weekends from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

title: Late Assignment Policy
text: Assignments submitted after the deadline are subject to a 10% grade deduction per day late, up to a maximum of three days, after which they are not accepted except for documented medical emergencies.

title: Hostel Curfew Policy
text: Hostel curfew is 8:00 PM on weekdays and 9:30 PM on weekends. Students returning after curfew must obtain written permission from the Chief Warden in advance.

title: Workshop Certificate Policy
text: Students who complete the workshop capstone demonstration may submit their project output for certificate verification through the workshop coordinator.
